text:
The plate is a square white plate, probably about 26 cm across. It holds sardine or mackerel fillets, roughly 3-4 pieces, laid over tomato slices. Wheat grains and a little greens and garnish sit on top.

Fish: about 3 fillets at roughly 40 g each, so about 120 g. At about 200 kcal per 100 g for oily fish, that is about 240 kcal.

Grains: about 30 g cooked, or about 50 kcal.

Tomato and greens: about 40 g, or about 10 kcal.

Oil: about 40 kcal.

Total mass is about 120 + 30 + 40 + 10 for oil and garnish, which is about 200 g. Total energy is about 340 kcal.
